Definition: Beon, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Beon means "in the dwelling: indwelling." It was a place or city in Reuben. You will find it in Numbers 32:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beon matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
